$comment: The layers' tool dependencies as one declared set, the shape of sfi/forts#25. Two readers: internal/tools checks for a tool at run time and names a missing one, and flake.nix puts the packaged set on every role binary's wrapper PATH and in devShells.default. `packaged` maps a binary to the nixpkgs attribute path that carries it. `ambient` is the binary the host must own: `attr` is what an operator installs it from, `why` is the reason the closure must not carry it. Declare a tool here before you exec it.

nix.why: it is the client of the host's own daemon; a role that runs it does so to build or to run a flake output the host already trusts
